findings.evidence: AUDIT_PLAN.md:170 mandates cascade to FOUR surfaces ('kiosk item hidden / POS grayed / KDS no new cards / OSS upsell removed') and KEY ASSERTION (:171) = 'item hidden on ALL surfaces ≤2s of toggle'. The spec only opens admin+POS+kiosk contexts (spec:14-20) and only hard-asserts cascade on POS (spec:355-358) and kiosk (spec:386-389). grep of the spec for 'oss|kds|order-status|upsell' = ZERO matches. KDS-side ('no new cards for an 86'd item') and OSS-side ('upsell removed') cascade are NEVER exercised — so the plan's 'ALL surfaces' claim is proven only for 2 of the 4 named surfaces. A KDS/OSS oversell regression would pass this spec green.
findings.fix_hint: Add a KDS context (chef@lecayenne.fr, private-branch.1) asserting an 86'd item produces no new KDS card / shows as unavailable, and an OSS/upsell context asserting the 86'd item is dropped from upsell. Or explicitly de-scope KDS/OSS in AUDIT_PLAN.md Wave N and downgrade its KEY ASSERTION from 'ALL surfaces' to 'POS+kiosk'.
findings.why_p2_not_p1: Coverage gap, not a demonstrated defect (REVIEWER_PROTOCOL P1 = proven user-visible defect; P1-objectivity rule AUDIT_PLAN:33-41 forbids blocking on an unmeasured surface). Crucially, the oversell vector is the ORDERING surfaces (kiosk+POS), both proven non-orderable. KDS/OSS are downstream DISPLAY surfaces: KDS shows only PLACED orders, so 'no new card for an 86'd item' is a structural CONSEQUENCE of the proven source-block (no order containing the item can be placed → no card can arrive) — not an independent oversell vector; an OSS upsell tap still routes back through the proven-disabled add-path. So the task's core 'truly non-orderable on BOTH kiosk AND POS' paranoia is fully discharged.

findings.evidence: Both cascade hard-asserts are GATED behind posTilePresentBefore / kioskCardPresentBefore. If the target item's tile/card is not located before the toggle (first-page featured filter, category walk miss, or a future seed change), the branch falls to recordDefect() — a non-fatal console.error — and the spec STILL PASSES with the cascade UNVERIFIED. For THIS run both flags were true (DOM confirms tile 22 in 02 + card 22 in 03), so the hard asserts genuinely executed; the soft-pass path is latent, not active. Reviewer must re-confirm presence each round rather than trust a green run.
findings.fix_hint: Promote posTilePresentBefore / kioskCardPresentBefore to HARD expects (the spec already requires an in-stock item exists; it should require that SAME item is visible on each observer surface before toggle), so a 'not found' becomes a loud failure instead of a silent skip.
